pages.text: Plasma cores are advanced energy sources used in end-game technology. They come in different types and purity levels:$(br)• Blue Plasma Core$(br)• Violet Plasma Core$(br)• Raw Blue Core$(br)• Raw Violet Core

pages.title: Blue Plasma Core
pages.text: Refined blue plasma core used in advanced machines.

pages.title: Violet Plasma Core
pages.text: High-energy violet plasma core for end-game technology.

pages.title: Raw Blue Core
pages.text: Unrefined blue plasma core, needs processing.

pages.title: Raw Violet Core
pages.text: Unrefined violet plasma core, needs processing.
